description: First National Equities Limited was incorporated in February 1995 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange in 2004, where it trades under the symbol FNEL as a brokerage house. It provides online equities trading, research, margin financing and margin trading, and was given the exchange's Top Companies Award in 2006. Its associated companies include First Pakistan Securities Limited, Switch Securities (Pvt.) Limited, First Florance Developers (Pvt.) Limited and MCD Pakistan Limited.
headOffice: FNE House, 179-B, Abu Bakar Block, New Garden Town, Lahore, Pakistan
